description:
Get Discord audit log entries with actor, target, changes, and event details. Requires View Audit Log.

Filter by user ID and by event code or name, including CHANNEL_POSITION_UPDATE and ROLE_POSITION_UPDATE. Discord can merge repeated actions into one entry, with options.count giving the combined count for these events.

Use before for older entries or after for newer entries. JSON returns an array by default. Set include_pagination or supply a cursor to get an object with entries and a continuation cursor when the page is full.

action_type.description: Filter by Discord audit event code or name, such as CHANNEL_POSITION_UPDATE

after.description: Return newer entries after this audit log ID, oldest first. Use '0' to start at the oldest entry.

before.description: Return older entries before this audit log ID, newest first

include_pagination.description: Include a continuation cursor with the results even when no before or after cursor is supplied

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

user_id.description: Filter by user who performed actions

name: discord_get_audit_log
title: Get Audit Log
